weeks.notes: Taper + Race A (Sep 12). 70/10/20. 6h. Treat as dress rehearsal at high quality, not peak-or-die. Bike NP 230-235W, run 4:00-4:05/km. Hold back first 2km.

sessions.notes: RACE A — Olympic distance, ~95% effort. Swim 1:48-1:52/100m. Bike NP 230-235W (IF 0.84-0.85). Run 4:00-4:05/km, hold back first 2km. 60-80g carbs/hr on bike. If HR >180 in first half of run, slow down — this is not A-race.
Recovery: easy spin 30min OR walk only. Full recovery after Race A.

weeks.notes: Race week. Goal: sub-2:25 primary, sub-2:20 stretch. Recover from Race A, sharpen, race Sep 19 full effort. Swim: draft if possible. Bike NP 230-240W, hold cadence 85-90. Run: open 4:10/km first km, settle to 4:00-4:05/km. Push back half of run.

sessions.notes: Bike 45min: 15wu / 3×3min @ Z5 (300W) / 2min rec / cd. Open the engine.
Swim 1500m: wu + 6×50 race pace + cd. Pool only.
Race opener brick bike: 25min (5wu / 3×1min @ race effort / 5cd). Wake the system.
Race opener brick run: 10min (4×30s @ race pace). Wake the legs.
RACE B — Olympic distance A-RACE. Full effort. Swim 1500m 27-28min. Bike 40km NP 230-240W. Run 10K open 4:10/km then 4:00-4:05/km. 60-80g carbs/hr on bike. Push km 5-9 of run. Don't fade.
Recovery: gentle walk + easy swim 20min. No effort.
